event.summary: Uninstall can leave an earlier private tmux server running
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 500548b9253b07a26fd03119679184b69544e31d. TLDR: Removing a remote host can leave a private tmux server that already outlived an earlier supervisor stop. Details: The changed Provisioning section removes the socket-addressed tmux stop after the systemd stop; its stated replacement ends the unit control group and explicitly covers terminal hosts with stop-terminal-hosts. A server already outside that group can remain, so the deletion intentionally narrows cleanup. Suggested bucket: other (residual process cleanup; no established loss of work or security route). Confidence: confirmed contract acceptance, source-only, not observed in execution. proposed_drop: SPEC_impl.md, Provisioning, explicitly states: "Uninstall has no tmux step: a private tmux server that outlived a supervisor stopped before uninstall (a host never updated to a release that ends it at startup, or one whose startup ending failed and whose supervisor was later stopped) keeps running. The maintainer accepted that residual on 2026-11-11 when the step was removed." possible_cover: that exact specification acceptance; no other coverage sources searched. Could-be-highest: no established route; surviving user processes are not lost processes. Caveat: this candidate concerns only the explicitly accepted out-of-control-group residual, not unrelated incorrect termination or a missing terminal-host cleanup.

event.summary: Removing the Mac tmux preflight does not remove a required runtime dependency
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 17a3fe858c5511a24b7403af15dd41c93bf69fd7. TLDR: Considered whether allowing the Mac app or local setup to proceed without tmux would break terminal startup or upgrade cleanup. Details: The changed specification explicitly states the supervisor creates terminals through terminal hosts and that the remaining old-terminal termination uses a socket connect and peer process signals, without requiring a tmux program (SPEC_impl.md 2784..2836). The pinned source search for FARHELM_TMUX, tmux::, tmux_preflight and tmux_probe in desktop, setup, supervisor and shared units found no remaining runtime executable call; matches are compatibility filtering, ignored old-unit documentation and tests. The changed CLI and bootstrap prerequisites agree with that replacement contract. Suggested bucket: other if a stale description alone were found; no failure established. Confidence: confirmed refutation from source and contract, not execution. proposed_drop: refuted by terminal-host ownership and executable-independent old-terminal cleanup at the cited pinned specification, with no remaining runtime tmux call in the searched source paths. possible_cover: none beyond the cited contract. Could-be-highest: no established route to losing work or security impact. Caveat: this does not assess the historical tmux implementation for independent bugs or claim complete review of the terminal-host implementation.

event.summary: The rewritten tab BROWSER contract preserves the ambient environment
event.detail: Reviewed commit: f96dd4363d97dc7e07dea5b8947c96be6bf912e8. TLDR: Considered whether changing the description from tmux environment passing to terminal-host child passing incorrectly promised preservation of an existing browser selection. A new host boundary that cleared ambient variables could have lost an inherited browser value when no string override was added. Details and source refutation: service/core.rs 13809..13857 constructs the tab environment and gives append_tab_browser the ambient OsString. launch.rs 1331..1350 lets explicit launch values win, then inherited values (including empty), then the generated fallback; an inherited non-UTF-8 value is intentionally not converted to a string override. Crucially service/core/host_tabs.rs 585..606 calls host_child_env(std::env::vars_os(), env, ...) and includes the result in ChildSpec. service/core/host_launch.rs 135..159 starts with the complete OsString base environment and overlays launch values; it does not clear the base or remove BROWSER. Thus the changed documentation accurately describes both ordinary string overrides and retained ambient non-UTF-8 values. Suggested bucket: other had this been only an incorrect internal environment contract; no user defect established. Confidence: confirmed source refutation, no execution. proposed_drop: refuted by the actual tab caller and host_child_env base-plus-overlay implementation at the cited paths. possible_cover: none. Could-be-highest: no established security or loss-of-work route; this considered concern was lost browser-selection behavior, not a new forwarding authority. Caveat: does not claim all external BROWSER consumers interpret generated templates successfully; those separate limitations are expressly described immediately after this paragraph. This candidate is newly checked during discovery, not a reported finding.
